question.prompt: Given \(a>b\), compare \(-2a\) and \(-2b\). Answer 1 if \(-2a\) is greater and \(-1\) if it is smaller.

solutions.explanation: Multiplying by a negative number reverses the direction of the inequality, so \(-2a<-2b\), and \(-2a\) is smaller.
solutions.title: Multiply by a negative number
